title: Courgette frittata
intro: Thick, soft frittata with golden courgettes, Parmigiano and basil.

steps.t: Thinly slice the courgettes into rounds and the spring onion into rings.
Cook them in a 26 cm non-stick pan with 2 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt until the courgettes are golden.
steps.label: Courgettes

steps.t: Beat the eggs with the Parmigiano, torn basil, salt and pepper.
Let the courgettes cool slightly and stir them into the eggs.
Heat the remaining oil in the pan, pour in the mixture and cook covered over low heat until the edges set.
steps.label: First side

oven.t: Pour the mixture into an oiled 24 cm dish and bake at 180°C for 20 minutes, until set in the centre.

steps.t: Flip the frittata onto a flat lid and slide it back into the pan.

oven.t: No need to flip it: let it rest 5 minutes in the dish.

steps.t: Cook the other side until golden and the centre is firm.
steps.label: Second side

oven.t: For a more golden top, slide it under the grill for 2 minutes.

steps.t: Serve warm or at room temperature, cut into wedges.

tips.t: Low heat and a lid: the frittata cooks through without burning underneath.
Swap the basil for mint and dot with 100 g ricotta.
Cold, between two slices of bread, it's the classic picnic sandwich; keeps 2 days in the fridge.

title: Eggs in purgatory
intro: Eggs gently poached in spicy tomato sauce, a Neapolitan home classic.

steps.t: Heat the oil with the crushed garlic and chilli in a wide pan over medium heat until the garlic is golden, then remove it.
Pour in the tomato sauce (a good jarred one works), check the salt and let it reduce a little.
steps.label: Sauce

steps.t: Use the back of a spoon to make 4 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Salt the whites lightly, cover and cook over low heat until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.
steps.label: Eggs

steps.t: Scatter with basil and serve at once, straight from the pan.

tips.t: Crack each egg into a cup first, then slide it into the well without breaking the yolk.
Add black olives and capers to the sauce for a puttanesca twist.
Bring crusty bread to mop up the sauce (gluten-free if needed).

title: Cheese soufflé
intro: Puffed and golden outside, creamy inside, with Gruyère and Parmigiano.

steps.t: Heat the oven to 200°C with a baking tray inside. Butter a 1.5 litre soufflé dish and dust it with Parmigiano.
Melt 40 g butter, add the flour, stir 1 minute, pour in the hot milk and cook, stirring, until thick.
steps.label: Base

steps.t: Take off the heat and beat in the yolks one at a time, then the Gruyère, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Whisk the whites with a pinch of salt to firm but not dry peaks.
Fold in a third of the whites to loosen the base, then the rest gently, lifting from the bottom.
Pour into the dish and run a finger around the inside rim so it rises straight.
Set the dish on the hot tray, lower to 190°C and bake without opening until risen and golden.
steps.label: Oven

steps.t: Serve at once: the centre should still be creamy.

tips.t: Don't open the oven for the first 20 minutes, or the soufflé will sink.
A teaspoon of Dijon mustard in the base brings out the cheese.
Try adding 100 g cooked spinach, squeezed dry and chopped, to the base.

title: Spanish tortilla
intro: Spain's potato and onion omelette, golden outside and soft in the middle.

steps.t: Peel the potatoes and slice them thinly; slice the onion. Salt everything.
Heat the oil in a 24 cm non-stick pan over medium-low heat and cook the potatoes and onion gently, without browning, until tender.
steps.label: Potatoes

steps.t: Drain them in a sieve, keeping the oil.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt, stir in the hot potatoes and let it sit.
steps.label: Rest

steps.t: Return 1 tbsp of the oil to the pan, heat over medium and pour in the mixture; cook until the edges set.
steps.label: First side

steps.t: Cover the pan with a plate, flip it over in one confident move and slide the tortilla back in.
Cook the other side until golden outside but still soft inside; 2 more minutes if you like it well set.
steps.label: Second side

steps.t: Let it cool for a few minutes before cutting.

tips.t: Resting the hot potatoes in the eggs is the secret: the tortilla holds together and stays juicy.
The drained oil is full of flavour: reuse it to sauté vegetables. The tortilla keeps 2 days chilled.

title: Egg curry
intro: Hard-boiled eggs in a spiced onion and tomato curry: cheap and full of flavour.

steps.t: Boil the eggs, then cool them in cold water and peel.
steps.label: Boil eggs

steps.t: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan and toast the cumin seeds until they sizzle.
Add the chopped onions and cook over medium heat until deep golden.
steps.label: Onions

steps.t: Add chopped garlic, ginger and green chilli for 1 minute, then the turmeric, coriander and chilli powder.
Pour in the tomatoes, salt and cook until the sauce thickens and the oil separates.
steps.label: Sauce

steps.t: Score the eggs with 3-4 shallow cuts, add them with the water and simmer gently.
steps.label: Simmer

steps.t: Sprinkle with garam masala and fresh coriander; serve with rice or chapati.

tips.t: Scoring the eggs lets the sauce seep right in to the yolk.
Serve with basmati rice and red onion sliced with lemon and salt.

title: Çılbır (Turkish eggs)
intro: Poached eggs on garlicky yogurt with chilli butter, the Turkish way.

steps.t: Mix the room-temperature yogurt with grated garlic and a pinch of salt and spread it in two shallow bowls.
Bring the water and vinegar to the boil in a wide pan, then lower the heat until barely simmering.
Crack each egg into a cup, swirl the water gently and slide the eggs in.
Poach until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.
steps.label: Eggs

steps.t: Meanwhile, melt the butter in a small pan, take it off the heat and stir in the chilli and paprika until red.
Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon, blot on paper and set them on the yogurt.
Spoon over the spiced butter, scatter with dill and serve at once.

tips.t: Use very fresh eggs: the whites hold together instead of spreading in the water.
Serve with warm bread to scoop up the yogurt and butter (gluten-free if needed).
